content.title: You can watch the 2026 Oscars tonight for less with this Hulu and Disney+ deal
content.text: AdvertisementReturn to HomepageOur experts independently review everything we recommend. If you buy through our links, we may earn commission.Watch the Oscars, The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives, Paradise and more with this great deal on the Disney+/Hulu bundle. (Jakub Porzycki/NurPhoto via Getty Images)(NurPhoto via Getty Images)MoreWe're still months away from Black Friday, but this March, there's a streaming deal that rivals the best holiday sales. For a limited time, you can get the Disney+/Hulu bundle for just $4.99/month for the next 3 months, saving $24 on the plan that typically costs $12.99/month. That means you can tune in to everything that both subscriptions have to offer, from Hulu shows like The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives (Season 4 arrives this week!), FX shows like Love Story and The Lowdown, and Disney+ content like Zootopia 2 (streaming March 11!), Bluey, and more. Plus, this year's Academy Awards will stream live on Hulu (even if you don't have the live TV plan!), so you can watch Hollywood's biggest night unfold live on Sunday, March 15 (or on-demand the next day).This deal is good for new and returning users, and it applies to the ad-based tier of the bundle. (And if you keep the plan for longer than three months, you'll be charged the regular monthly rate once the trial period is over.) Here's how to get this great discount on the Disney+ and Hulu bundle.How to get the Disney+/Hulu bundle for $5/month: Get the Disney+/Hulu bundle for $4.99Disney+ and Hulu bundle A basic, ad-supported subscription to the Disney+ Hulu bundle typically starts at $12.99 a month, but right now you can get ad-supported Disney+ and Hulu for just $4.99 a month for three months. On the Disney+ side, that means access to all the new and classic Disney princess movies, plus shows like The Simpsons, Bluey and more. Hulu will get you a library of Hulu Originals like Paradise and Chad Powers, FX shows like The Lowdown, reality programs like The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives, the Scrubs revival, and lots of live programming the day after it airs. This Disney+/Hulu deal is good through March 24, so grab it while it lasts. *Note, the Academy Awards will only stream live on Hulu. If you're a bundle subscriber who usually watches everything on Disney+, you just need to activate your Hulu account via Disney+ first to log in to Hulu's platform. $4.99/month for 3 months at Disney+How to watch the Oscars on Hulu in 2026The 98th annual Academy Awards will air live on ABC on Sunday, March 15, 2026. Official red carpet coverage begins at 6:30 p.m. ET and the ceremony itself, hosted by Conan O'Brien, begins at 7 p.m. ET.AdvertisementAdvertisementTypically, to stream live events like this, you'd need a subscription to a live TV service, but this year, you can watch the entire ceremony live with any Hulu plan.
